notes: The source agrees with the served counts: Omega-3 166/7740 and Placebo Omega-3 135/7740. These are counts of participants with fatal or non-fatal atrial fibrillation events. Each comparison group pools two factorial arms: Omega-3+Aspirin and Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin; Placebo Omega-3+Aspirin and Placebo Omega-3+Placebo Aspirin. Separate atrial fibrillation counts for the four factorial arms are NOT_IN_PACKET. The selected outcome states participant denominators without explicitly qualifying their analysis basis. Percentages are not printed for this outcome. Group IDs OG000 and OG001 are taken only from this outcome measure.
